en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard featuring a large illustration of an early biplane flying above a panoramic photograph of a military tent camp. In ornate script across the middle is the phrase 'Souvenir de Mailly-le-Camp'. Numerous conical tents and soldiers are visible on the ground, with low buildings and a tree line in the background. A small printed caption at the bottom right reads 'Bazar Militaire A. Nieps'. The card is numbered '502' in the upper left.
